title: what do we all feel about the mall world?

classification.question_topic: Asking what strengthens/weakens Mall World dreams; whether there is meaning/agenda; and tactics to realize/lucid dream because the dreams feel real/frantic and hard to control

meta.initial_emotion: exhausted but excited to go back
meta.author_theory: Mentions trying to identify causes (hormones, planetary aspects) and asks if there is a hidden meaning/agenda; says it feels very real and frantic and hard to gain control

interactions.description: First remembered Mall World dream occurred while the dreamer was in the process of passing a kidney stone (waking-life condition mentioned as concurrent). In the dream they had a sidekick: a mini-pony named Thomasz.
After the dream, the dreamer got a mini-pony as soon as they could (waking-life action linked to the dream content).
Across ~3 years: dreams of the same places every night; some nights somewhere new; dreamer reports it is obviously all in the same world.
Dream included a drill bit; the next day seeing a drill bit while awake triggered a strong tethered feeling and a sense of being able to 'see into the dream' around the drill bit.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post is primarily a question/meta discussion about recurring Mall World dreams; it contains minimal concrete scene/location detail. Mentions recurring 'same places' but does not describe any specific mall/school/hotel/etc. The only specific dream content is a first dream with a mini-pony sidekick and a separate mention of a drill bit appearing in a dream.
